function coastSDF(S, nSeg, N) {
  const x0 = RECT[0], z0 = RECT[1], size = RECT[2], cell = size / N;
  const segDist2 = (px, pz, k) => {
    const ax = S[k * 4], az = S[k * 4 + 1], bx = S[k * 4 + 2], bz = S[k * 4 + 3];
    const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az, l2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1e-9;
    let t = ((px - ax) * dx + (pz - az) * dz) / l2; t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t;
    const ex = px - ax - dx * t, ez = pz - az - dz * t;
    return ex * ex + ez * ez;
  };
  // inside mask by even-odd scanline fill
  const inside = new Uint8Array(N * N);
  const xs = [];
  for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) {
    const pz = z0 + (j + 0.5) * cell; xs.length = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < nSeg; k++) {
      const az = S[k * 4 + 1], bz = S[k * 4 + 3];
      if ((az > pz) !== (bz > pz)) { const ax = S[k * 4], bx = S[k * 4 + 2]; xs.push(ax + (pz - az) * (bx - ax) / (bz - az)); }
    }
    xs.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    for (let q = 0; q + 1 < xs.length; q += 2) {
      let i0 = Math.ceil((xs[q] - x0) / cell - 0.5), i1 = Math.floor((xs[q + 1] - x0) / cell - 0.5);
      i0 = Math.max(i0, 0); i1 = Math.min(i1, N - 1);
      for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) inside[j * N + i] = 1;
    }
  }
  // coarse unsigned distance, brute force
  const C = 256, cc = size / C, coarse = new Float32Array(C * C);
  for (let j = 0; j < C; j++) for (let i = 0; i < C; i++) {
    const px = x0 + (i + 0.5) * cc, pz = z0 + (j + 0.5) * cc;
    let m = 1e18; for (let k = 0; k < nSeg; k++) { const d = segDist2(px, pz, k); if (d < m) m = d; }
    coarse[j * C + i] = Math.sqrt(m);
  }
  const sampleC = (px, pz) => {
    const u = (px - x0) / cc - 0.5, v = (pz - z0) / cc - 0.5;
    const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(C - 2, Math.floor(u))), j = Math.max(0, Math.min(C - 2, Math.floor(v)));
    const fu = Math.min(Math.max(u - i, 0), 1), fv = Math.min(Math.max(v - j, 0), 1);
    const a = coarse[j * C + i], b = coarse[j * C + i + 1], c = coarse[(j + 1) * C + i], d = coarse[(j + 1) * C + i + 1];
    return (a * (1 - fu) + b * fu) * (1 - fv) + (c * (1 - fu) + d * fu) * fv;
  };
  // segment buckets for the exact near-shore band
  const B = 40, BN = Math.ceil(size / B), band = 160;
  const buckets = Array.from({ length: BN * BN }, () => []);
  for (let k = 0; k < nSeg; k++) {
    const ax = S[k * 4], az = S[k * 4 + 1], bx = S[k * 4 + 2], bz = S[k * 4 + 3];
    const i0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Math.min(ax, bx) - band - x0) / B)), i1 = Math.min(BN - 1, Math.floor((Math.max(ax, bx) + band - x0) / B));
    const j0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Math.min(az, bz) - band - z0) / B)), j1 = Math.min(BN - 1, Math.floor((Math.max(az, bz) + band - z0) / B));
    for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) buckets[j * BN + i].push(k);
  }
  const out = new Float32Array(N * N);
  for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) {
    const pz = z0 + (j + 0.5) * cell;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const px = x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell;
      let d = sampleC(px, pz);
      if (d < band - 2 * cc) {
        const bl = buckets[Math.min(BN - 1, Math.floor((pz - z0) / B)) * BN + Math.min(BN - 1, Math.floor((px - x0) / B))];
        let m = 1e18; for (const k of bl) { const q = segDist2(px, pz, k); if (q < m) m = q; }
        if (m < 1e17) d = Math.sqrt(m);
      }
      out[j * N + i] = inside[j * N + i] ? d : -d;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
